messages:
sean-sales: Quick sync — BigBank wants a short POC to validate our streaming SDK handling of tool/function calls + structured output. They care about backpressure, cost projection for a 30k qps burst test, and SOC2 answers. can we do this next week?
anya-se: yes. we can stand up a reserved-capacity pilot for the test window. recommended approach: websocket streaming + function_call mode, with structured schema output enabled. I can draft a 30-min runbook.
sean-sales: perfect. pricing? they asked for a rough cost delta between hosted vs dedicated for pilot (24h ramp, 30k qps peak).
mike-runtime: quick note on backpressure: 30k qps sustained is heavy — needs batching + flow control. suggest client-side windowing + server ack. we expose SSE/websocket credits and a per-connection inflight limit. if you hit the inflight cap we'll return 429 with Retry-After.
mike-runtime: example headers we recommend the client send:
```
POST /v1/stream HTTP/1.1
Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>
X-Redwood-Client: bigbank-poc
X-Redwood-Session: abc123
```
anya-se: for function calls, use the SDK's streaming function API. sample payload snippet: 
```json
{"type":"input","text":"summarize transactions","tool_request":{"name":"tx_lookup","args":{"account_id":"123"}}}
```
we'll stream partial tokens while the tool executes and then emit a final structured result.
olivia-ae: security side — they sent a 40-question security questionnaire. can we get the SOC2 evidence and KMS/HSM answers? turnaround 48h ideally.
jen-security-bot: SOC2 report and KMS architecture doc links: https://redwood.internal/soc2 (sensitive) and https://redwood.internal/kms-arch. I can pre-fill common Qs: key rotation, access reviews, and token handling. ping me with the questionnaire PDF.
sean-sales: thanks. also they asked about function-call failure modes and automatic retries / fallbacks to a cheaper model during high load. any notes?
mike-runtime: we have routing policy rules: canary -> primary -> low-cost fallback. on tool-call failure we support idempotent retries with exponential backoff. logging includes per-call trace_id. for POC we can enable fallback to quantized model in the same family to save tokens.
anya-se: I'll put together: 1) 30-min lab runbook, 2) pricing sketch (hosted vs dedicated for 24h), 3) security Q&A draft, 4) client sample code for streaming + tool calls.
sean-sales: awesome. can you attach sample prompt set they want to run? they gave 12 prompts (mix of short/long).
anya-se: yep — ask them to upload prompts and any sample tool schemas. I'll schedule a 30-min lab next Tue 10am PT. tagging @olivia-ae to confirm internal approvals for reserved pilot. :thumbsup:
olivia-ae: confirmed — I'll sign the pilot SOW and request security docs.
sean-sales: cool. mike — can you allocate a 2x small GPU pool for the window and enable detailed token telemetry?
mike-runtime: will do. i'll open a runbook ticket and enable per-route tracing.
sean-sales: thanks team, i'll reply to BigBank with timelines and CC the security doc link.
jen-security-bot: reminder: redact PII before sharing traces.
sean-sales: noted. thanks all.
